status_vocabulary.client_briefing: Material supplied to or prepared for the expert; not an expert conclusion unless authorship is established.
status_vocabulary.draft: Located copy expressly identifies itself as draft or otherwise lacks final/signature evidence.
status_vocabulary.transmitted: Evidence of transmission is located; transmission alone does not establish court filing.
status_vocabulary.author_reported_filed: The author later stated that the document was filed; independent docket confirmation remains required.
status_vocabulary.court_confirmed_role: A court-originating source confirms the expert's procedural participation/role.
status_vocabulary.court_confirmed_filed: A filing receipt, certified index, docket entry or judicial source specifically confirms incorporation of the document.

rules: Do not collapse creation, transmission, receipt, filing, timeliness and judicial use into one status.
Do not label an item extemporaneous unless the applicable deadline and the actual filing/service date establish lateness.
Not filed is not equivalent to filed late.
Later discovery is not equivalent to late filing.
A contemporaneous document can be ex-ante evidence of an issue being documented without proving court notice or receipt.
Client instructions and briefing material must remain separate from expert-authored conclusions.
A draft must not be described as final or signed without a matched final copy.
Filing or reuse in one proceeding/track does not establish filing, knowledge or effect in another.
Do not publish private contact details, fees, family information, confidential strategy or full reports carrying reliance/distribution restrictions without separate clearance.
